experiment: LEXACT M2: one frozen intra-eval parallel fused FWHT+cis kernel, T=4

hypothesis.one_sentence: Same unitaries as M1. FWHT and X-mixers over disjoint butterflies in 4 threads; diagonal phases applied as cis from real angles, not numpy.exp of a stored complex vector.
hypothesis.why_this_one: A numpy ping-pong SIMD FWHT was slower than M1 at N18 (extra buffer traffic). This axis keeps M1's in-place butterflies and parallelizes them at frozen T=4, the host width and the campaign worker count. T is not scanned.

physics_frozen.ansatz: original Nov3 shared gamma/theta, full s1/s2/s3, interleaved packing

success: Steady energy at N18 L1 Nov3 faster than M1, with state vs reference |Δ|∞ ≤ 1e-12 and SPSA traces |ΔE| ≤ 1e-10, same start/candidate. If not, stop this axis. Not a GR adoption.
